waste_categories.name: Plastic Waste
donts: Do not dispose of multi-layered laminate wrappers.
Do not leave dirty food residue inside.
waste_categories.environmental_impact: Takes up to 450 years to decompose in landfills.

waste_categories.name: Glass Waste
dos: Rinse and remove metal or plastic caps.
Sort by clear, brown, and green glass if bins are separated.
donts: Do not mix broken window panes or lightbulbs.
waste_categories.environmental_impact: 100% recyclable endlessly without loss of purity.

waste_categories.name: Hazardous Battery
dos: Drop strictly into designated e-waste bins.
donts: Never throw in general household waste bins.
waste_categories.environmental_impact: Contains toxic heavy metals that leach into groundwater.

waste_categories.name: Electronic Waste
dos: Hand over to campus e-waste recycling kiosks.
donts: Do not burn wires to extract copper.

waste_categories.name: Metal & Cans
waste_categories.description: Aluminum cans, tin food cans, and clean foil.
dos: Rinse clean and flatten beverage cans.
donts: Do not include aerosol cans with liquid residue.
waste_categories.environmental_impact: Recycling aluminum saves 95% energy vs raw mining.

waste_categories.name: Organic Waste
waste_categories.description: Food scraps, fruit peels, and leaves.
dos: Deposit directly into green composting bins.
donts: Do not mix plastic packaging with food waste.
